Left side: drag to walk. Right side: drag to look. Buttons: Use (sit, stand, drive), Run, Skip ⏭, Time, Camera, Menu.
Board the train through an open door. Announcements are recorded for every station: Bulgarian (female voice) and English (male voice). Four kinds of train run at random: the ivory-and-blue and the red Rusich, the Škoda Varsovia and the green-and-white set.

Линия · Line

Отиди на станция · Go to station

Real inter-station distances, 66.86 km in all. Travel times follow the distance: about 77 minutes end to end at ×1, plus dwell time. Beyond НДК the line runs on underground to Европейски съюз, Джеймс Баучер and the terminus Витоша. West of Сливница the line comes up at Обеля (open cutting, the metro depot), runs in a covered tube on a viaduct to the elevated Ломско шосе and dives back underground before Бели Дунав. Between Жолио Кюри and Младост 1 the line runs in the open under a glass tube; after Искърско шосе it climbs out into a covered tube and onto the viaduct to the airport.

Driving: sit in the driver's seat of the leading cab. W / S move the controller between traction and brake, Space emergency brake, O opens and C closes the doors, P hands control back to the automatic driver. Stop with the front of the train at the stop board. On Line M3 the train has to stand within ±0.5 m of its mark: only then do the platform screen doors open (first the platform doors, then the train doors; on departure the other way round).
